title: Sidecar store test
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test client of the Sidecar companion's store link (Storage phase, 2026-11-04), for test builds only, never a release: at each new session it declares a lock set, writes a record of 600 bytes and reads it back from the Pi, writes and reads a small one (the companion's cache), and reads the record the previous session left (pattern 1's handle). Boxes at the bottom right of the screen show each step's result.
